MOLEX PRIMARY-SOURCE TRANSCRIPTION FOR AQROOT D-781
Document: 5055700003-PS, Revision A6, approved 2025-04-25
Title: Micro-Lock Plus 2.0 Wire to Wire Connector System, single row tin plating
Source: https://www.molex.com/content/dam/molex/molex-dot-com/products/automated/en-us/productspecificationpdf/505/505570/5055700003-PS-000.pdf
Section 4.2 rated current and applicable wires:
AWG22 3.4 A
AWG24 3.0 A
AWG26 2.6 A
Section 4.3 reference derating, 2 circuits: AWG22 4.7 A; AWG24 3.9 A; AWG26 2.9 A. Reference values only; AQROOT uses section 4.2 rated current, not the derating reference value.
Section 4.4 ambient range: -40 C to +105 C, including terminal temperature rise.
Section 6.1.5 temperature rise at maximum rated current: 30 C MAX.
Section 6.2.2 crimp pull-out: AWG22 39.2 N MIN; AWG24 29.4 N MIN; AWG26 19.6 N MIN.
Series identities: receptacle terminal 505572; receptacle housing 505570; plug terminal 213720; plug housing 213719.
Exact AQROOT parts checked on Molex product/drawing pages 2026-09-19: 5055700201 2-circuit receptacle housing; 5055721000 female terminal 22/24/26 AWG; 2137192021 2-circuit black plug housing; 2137201000 male terminal 22/24/26 AWG.
Section 10: 2-9 circuit harnesses recommend at least 35 mm free wire before bundling/twisting.
This file is a concise engineering transcription, not a replacement for the vendor PDF. Re-check the linked primary document at procurement.
Molex series chart 217501, checked 2026-09-19: 2175012101 = Micro-Lock Plus 2.0 female-to-pigtail, matte tin, 75.00 mm, 26 AWG, RED, UL 10002.
Molex series chart 217501, checked 2026-09-19: 2175011101 = Micro-Lock Plus 2.0 female-to-pigtail, matte tin, 75.00 mm, 26 AWG, BLACK, UL 10002.
Source: https://www.molex.com/en-us/products/series-chart/217501

--- ADDED AT D-793 / R12-01: THE PRIMARY DOCUMENT ITSELF IS NOW IN THE TREE ---
D-792 recorded 5055700003-PS as "not retrievable from this environment" and DECLARED the
contact-resistance terms at 20 mOhm initial / 30 mOhm aged on that basis.  Round-12 states
that Molex primary evidence supports a 40 mOhm post-durability/environment criterion, and
it does: the document retrieved at D-793 through the Internet Archive snapshot
20231101174835 of the same molex.com URL and is archived beside this file as
molex-5055700003-PS-A1.pdf (sha256 0218c6300aa4e4b4906e7607b7e033ece51c2adc6439ae8be90ce8e659942440,
13 pages) with a pdftotext -layout rendering as molex-5055700003-PS-A1.txt
(sha256 9d84e54fa59b772a4109f8d57e5e66d10855169128d33522c731ef6b70d4d9b2).

REVISION DISCREPANCY, RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED.  The retrieved copy is REVISION A1
(initial release; drawn 2021-03-18, approved 2022-02-18, change 748551 dated 2023-05-04/05).
The transcription above cites Revision A6 approved 2025-04-25, taken from the Molex product
page at D-781.  Every row this repository had already transcribed is present and IDENTICAL
in the A1 copy -- 4.2 rated current 3.4/3.0/2.6 A, 4.3 derating reference 4.7/3.9/2.9 A,
4.4 ambient -40..+105 C, 6.1.5 temperature rise 30 C MAX, 6.2.2 crimp pull-out
39.2/29.4/19.6 N MIN, section 10 free-wire 35 mm -- so the two revisions agree everywhere
the design already depended on them.  The rows below are read from the A1 copy and are the
ones D-793 RULES at; they are conservative in the direction that matters.

Section 6.1.1 Contact Resistance: 20 milliohms MAX.
  Condition: "Mate connectors and measured by dry circuit, 20mV MAX., 10 mA MAX. and
  SUBTRACT WIRE CONDUCTOR RESISTANCE.  Refer to paragraph 8 Contact resistance measuring
  point. (JIS C5402-2-1)".  So the figure is the mated contact pair ALONE and the harness
  conductor is counted separately, which is how aqroot_power_model itemises it.
Section 6.1.4 Contact Resistance on crimped portion: 5 milliohms MAX.
  Condition: "Crimp the applicable wire to the terminal, measured by dry circuit,
  20 mV MAX., 10 mA MAX."  D-792 carried 1 mOhm per crimp as a DECLARED allowance; the
  manufacturer's published maximum is five times that.
Post-durability / post-environmental criterion, 40 milliohms MAX Contact Resistance, stated
identically in EVERY one of these rows:
  6.2.6 Repeated Insertion / Withdrawal, 30 cycles at <=10 cycles/minute
  6.2.7 Vibration, 10-55-10 Hz 1.5 mm P-P, 2 h in each of X/Y/Z
  6.2.8 Mechanical Shock, half sine 490 m/s2 {50 G} 11 ms, 18 shocks
  6.3.1 Temperature Cycling, 5 cycles -40+/-3 C / +105+/-2 C, 30 min each
  6.3.2 Heat Resistance, 105+/-2 C for 96 h
  6.3.3 Cold Resistance, -40+/-3 C for 96 h
  6.3.4 Humidity, 60+/-2 C at 90-95 % RH for 96 h
  6.3.5 Salt Spray, 5+/-1 % NaCl, 48+/-4 h at 35+/-2 C
  6.3.6 SO2 Gas, 50+/-5 ppm at 40+/-2 C for 24 h
  6.3.7 NH3 Gas, 28 % NH3 solution, 40 minutes
Section 4.5 Durability: tin plated, 30 cycles.
Section 6.2.4 Crimp Terminal Retention Force: 25.0 N {2.55 kgf} MIN.
Section 6.2.5 Housing Lock Strength, 2-3 circuit: 25.0 N {2.55 kgf} MIN.
